title: Doxycycline Prophylaxis for Prevention of Sexually Transmitted Infections
official: Doxycycline Prophylaxis for Prevention of Sexually Transmitted Infections Among Adolescent and Young Adult Females in the United States
summary: The goal of this open-label, randomized trial is to assess the efficacy of doxycycline prophylaxis in reducing incidences of bacterial sexually transmitted infections (STIs) among adolescent and young adult females while also evaluating acceptability and antimicrobial resistance in order to inform public health policy.

interventions.name: Doxycycline hyclate delayed released 200 mg weekly
Per standard of care with quarterly STI testing/treatment and sexual health counseling

sites.f: San Francisco Department of Public Health
